name: Hamstring stretch (lying)
summary: On your back, a strap around the foot, raise the straight leg until the back of the thigh pulls.
setup: Lie on your back, side-on to the phone at floor level, working leg nearest. Loop a strap or towel around the foot, keep the knee straight and draw the leg up toward vertical until you feel the stretch. Hold.
brief: Lie on your back. Loop a strap or towel around the foot, keep the knee straight, and draw the leg up toward vertical until the hamstring pulls.
why: The leg angle from the floor shows how far up it is, so the timer only runs while the leg is actually held high.
tempo: Ease in over 5 s, hold, ease out.
progression: Take the leg higher; point the toes up.
regression: Bend the other knee; stop lower.
contraindications: Pins and needles down the leg, or back pain during the hold.

faults.label: Knee bending to cheat the stretch
faults.tip: A bent knee moves the stretch off the hamstring. Lower the leg until it can stay straight.

faults.label: Hip lifting off the floor
faults.tip: Keep the other leg and both hips on the floor; the stretch should be in the thigh, not the back.

faults.label: Other leg lifting off the floor
faults.tip: If the other leg rises the pelvis has tipped and the stretch is coming from the back.

faults.label: Bouncing into the stretch
faults.tip: A steady hold lengthens the muscle; bouncing makes it tighten to protect itself.

guide.stop: Nerve-like tingling, or pain in the lower back.
guide.cannotSee: The knee bending slightly, and the toes pointing.

points.t: Knee straight, leg held toward vertical.
Hips and shoulders flat on the floor.
